this paper presents a robust method to perform video frame interpolation by combining the motion estimation and pixel interpolation steps into a single convolution process, and the experiments show that the method is capable of handling challenging scenarios such as occlusions, blur, and sudden changes in brightness.

we propose a novel video interpolation method that is based on adaptive convolution and can gracefully handle challenges like blur, occlusion and brightness change.
the convolution kernel captures both motion estimation and pixel interpolation, and it is adaptive to the spatial location of the pixel.
we present a novel and effective formulation for video frame interpolation.

a deep convolutional neural network can be effectively used for video frame interpolation without relying on optical flow estimation.
video frame interpolation can be formulated as a single convolutional process and can be solved using a deep neural network.
